source: ASPEN Paediatric and Neonatal Nutrition Support Handbook, Third Edition: Growth Monitoring, term infants and paediatric patients, 'Reference normal growth velocity'
provenance: Transcribed by hand from a screenshot Edison supplied on 2026-11-08. NOT checked against the handbook. Maria or Edison to verify every value before any clinical use (I59).
bands_in_months: Each band runs from from_months up to, not including, to_months. Months are 30.4375 days.

bands.girls_note: The source shows 21-21 for girls, a range with identical ends. That looks like a typing error in the source. Treated as not usable until checked.

bands.note: Source row '2 - <4 years', not split by sex.
Source row '4 - 7 years', not split by sex. Only the part under 5 years is used here.

not_transcribed: Rows for 7 years and older: the engine screens children under 5.
Length and height velocity: beyond 12 months the source gives one value, not a range, and length measurement error is large compared with the daily rates. Not used (D160).

Preterm infant monitoring (15-20 g/kg/d, length over 1 cm/week, head circumference 0.8-1 cm/week, initial weight loss up to 15% regained in 10-14 days): needs per-kg rates and head circumference. Not used (D161).
